verdict.rationale: Muse is itself a built-in personal AI agent: users tell it what to get done in chat (mobile, Mac or WhatsApp), set goals and tasks it tracks in a Goals tab, and it keeps working on a schedule and in response to events, with approval cards before actions like emails and purchases. App-store reviews and an HN commenter corroborate real-world use. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence of reliable delegation under heavy load (one community stress test reported the agent control plane timing out).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp.
Once you've set a goal or a task, Muse continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up
The Goals tab is where Muse keeps track of all this for you, and you can interact directly there or talk to it about these tasks in chat.
It manages email, books dinners, tracks budgets, and finds deals, with your approval.
I get more done with muse in 30 minutes than I do in 2 hours with chat gpt.
